purpose: Deterministic DEV qualification of the six C2 foundation capability contracts. These cases validate method coverage and anti-rigidity properties; they are not outcome-level claims about Codex.

cases.scenario: An unfamiliar brownfield repository needs a material feature change and the responsible code is not named.
A tiny local edit has obvious responsible code and should not trigger repository-wide exploration.
The repository answers ordinary technical choices but one product decision remains genuinely ambiguous.
required_patterns: do not ask the user to choose technical details
source code, tests, manifests, or docs

cases.scenario: A non-expert user describes an outcome but not the engineering details required to make it credible.
A small feature must not become an enterprise checklist or silently widened scope.
required_patterns: do not add generic non-functional requirements by reflex
skip a formal acceptance contract for trivial

cases.scenario: Acceptance criteria need observable proof and must distinguish evidence gaps from success.
A multi-layer change needs the smallest dependency-aware path rather than a ceremonial long plan.
required_patterns: verification is part of the plan

cases.scenario: Some file-level details are uncertain and the plan must remain adaptable under new repository evidence.
A trivial local edit should receive a tiny plan and no invented process overhead.
required_patterns: three precise steps are better than twenty generic ones
plan can shrink for small tasks

cases.scenario: A reproducible bug should have truthful pre-fix evidence that fails for the intended reason.
required_patterns: do not fabricate a pre-fix failure

cases.scenario: The repository already has a test system and SEF must not impose a universal framework or coverage percentage.
required_patterns: do not impose a universal line-coverage threshold
avoid creating a parallel test framework

cases.scenario: Bootstrap/infrastructure work has no meaningful pre-implementation executable behavior and must not fake TDD.
required_patterns: do not force a synthetic red phase
no meaningful executable behavior exists yet

cases.scenario: A non-obvious cross-layer failure has several plausible causes and needs causal diagnosis.
An intermittent failure passes once after a change but that is insufficient evidence of a fix.
required_patterns: reduction in failure frequency is not proof of elimination

cases.scenario: The agent is tempted to patch multiple hypotheses simultaneously rather than learn from an experiment.
required_patterns: one causal variable at a time

cases.scenario: A task is implemented locally but the user did not ask for deployment, so the completion claim must stay narrow.
Some required evidence cannot run in the current environment and must not be relabeled PASS.
Implementation touched more than planned and verification must follow the actual change surface with repository-native checks.
